description: This file is a Java unit test class for testing ConfigWithFallback, focusing on configuration fallback logic, immutability, and exception handling.

classes.name: ConfigWithFallbackTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing ConfigWithFallback behavior, immutability, and error handling.

methods.name: initTestFixture
methods.description: Initializes the test configuration before all tests using ConfigFactory.load.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Tests that ConfigWithFallback instances and associated Config objects are immutable.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullOriginalConfig
methods.description: Verifies that creating an instance with a null original config throws a DittoConfigError.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullConfigPath
methods.description: Verifies that passing a null config path throws a DittoConfigError.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullFallBackValues
methods.description: Checks that passing null fallback values results in a DittoConfigError.

methods.name: tryToGetInstanceWithConfigWithWrongTypeAtConfigPath
methods.description: Ensures that wrong type at config path throws a DittoConfigError with appropriate message.

methods.name: useFallBackValuesIfConfigHasNoNestedConfigAtExpectedPath
methods.description: Tests that fallback values are used when nested config is missing at the specified path.

methods.name: configWithEmptyFallBackValuesRemainsSameUnwrapped
methods.description: Checks that a ConfigWithFallback with no fallback values remains equivalent to the original config.

methods.name: useFallBackValuesIfNotSetInOriginalConfig
methods.description: Tests that fallback values are used when the original config does not set certain keys.

methods.name: ignoreFallBackValuesIfSetInOriginalConfig
methods.description: Verifies that fallback values are ignored if the key is already set in the original config.

methods.name: getConfigPathReturnsRelativePathIfConfigWithFallbackIsBuiltFromPlainConfig
methods.description: Ensures that getConfigPath returns the relative path when built from a plain config.

methods.name: getConfigPathReturnsAbsolutePathIfDefaultScopedConfigIsBuiltFromScopedConfig
methods.description: Checks that getConfigPath returns the absolute path when built from a scoped config.
